How did Pakistan's PNS Ghazi submarine sink during the 1971 Indo-Pak War?
What was its mission, why was it near Visakhapatnam, and what led to its mysterious sinking? In this exclusive conversation, Naveen Pandita takes us through one of the most intriguing chapters in Indian naval history.
Watch this fascinating story from the 1971 War.
